# STEEZY Studio

> STEEZY (STEEZY, s.r.o.) is a branding and design studio from Brno, Czech Republic, founded in 2019. We are a strategic design partner for market leaders, ambitious challengers and cultural pioneers, with clients across Europe, the USA, the UAE and Hong Kong, from Fortune 100 companies to start-ups.

Artists and engineers work side by side in the studio. Our designers cover graphic design, photography, video, CGI, product design and architecture, so one team can take a brand from strategy to launch.

## What we do

- Brand identity and transformation: brand strategy, visual identity, design systems and guidelines
- Product and service launches: packaging and unboxing, product CGI and 3D, launch assets, physical activations
- Digital presence and e-commerce: UX/UI and web design, branded e-commerce, custom web development
- Growth and campaigns: campaign concepts, high-end video, motion and 3D, social media content
